title: PRISMA – A pilot randomized phase II trial on social prescriptions and micro learning to improve care for cancer patients and their support persons
summary: The PRISMA study investigates how care for cancer patients and their support persons can be improved through additional supportive care offers. Beyond medical treatment, many affected individuals have further needs, for example in coping with symptoms and everyday challenges, accessing supportive services, or understanding health-related information. The study therefore evaluates a supportive care approach consisting of social prescriptions, microlearning (brief, easy-to-understand learning units) and an app for regular symptom tracking. The aim is to examine whether this form of support can be implemented in routine care and is well accepted by participants. In addition, the study explores whether there are first indications of positive effects on quality of life, self-efficacy, knowledge of health and care, and the use of healthcare and supportive care services. For this purpose, cancer patients and their support persons are assigned to different study groups within and are assessed repeatedly during the course of the study.
conditions: Malignant melanoma, Colorectal carcinoma, Hematologic neoplasms, Lung cancer

interventions.name: Intervention arm: Participants in the intervention arm receive a complex supportive care intervention in addition to usual care. The intervention includes a social prescription with individually tailored recommendations for supportive services, microlearning videos on relevant health-related topics,
Control arm: Participants receive usual care according to local care structures at the respective study site without additional study-specific intervention.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1) diagnosis of early-stage or advanced-stage lung cancer, colorectal cancer, hematological neoplasm or malignant melanoma 
2) primary diagnosis within the past 12 months
3) expected survival of at least 18 months
4) attendance at the medical oncology units of participating hospitals
5) ECOG Performance Status 0-2
6) sufficient German language proficiency to complete questionnaires and interviews
7) ability to name an eligible SP
8) provision auf written informed cosent
Exclusion criteria:
1) inability to provide informed consent  
2) inability independently complete interviews and/or questionnaires due to impaired speech, vigilance, or comprehension.
